The selector binds on user_teams.team_id = Test Workspace joined to users.email = hubert@gmail.com, yielding the single membership row (U06HUBERT23, T01WORKSPACE, role='member'). The admin-role negatives (Robert Walsh, Morgan Freeman) and the same-role negative (Artem Bogdanov) are excluded solely by the email-join condition, demonstrating that role value alone cannot substitute for the identifying email.
